description: Gasleidingen en elektriciteitsnet; 1930 - 1998 is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CBS OpenData. De tabel bevat gegevens over de gas- en elektriciteitsnetten voor de jaren 1930 tot en met 1998. Gegevens beschikbaar: Vanaf 1930 per 5 jaar en vanaf 1935 per jaar. Status van de cijfers: Alle cijfers tot en met verslagjaar 1998 zijn definitief. Wijziging per 5 september 2008 Geen, deze tabel is stopgezet. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher CBS OpenData. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ATOM, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2025-12-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
